answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the crystal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the juniper of the next round.
